bot.name: eval
bot.why: A dedicated bot, not the landing page's demo. The demo indexes a capped slice of a site larger than the cap, so which pages it holds shifts between crawls — a moving corpus measures the crawl, not the system. This slice fits under the cap entirely, so a failure means retrieval or the prompt changed.
